scope: Shopping outcomes and observed usable shopping reach on selected public storefronts
outcomeAggregation: Equal task mean within each store, then equal store mean. Headline requires all 30 task cells assessable. No partial-credit judgments.
reachAggregation: Equal interface-type mean within each store, then equal store mean. Headline requires all 25 cells resolved. Verified lower bound always uses all 25 cells.

interfaces.label: Shopping chat
interfaces.description: A conversational entry point that provides usable shopping assistance.

interfaces.label: Product-page Q&A / FAQ
interfaces.description: Provider-powered product-specific assistance embedded on a product page. Static merchant FAQ copy alone does not count.

interfaces.label: Embedded recommendations
interfaces.description: Provider-powered interactive product recommendations outside the chat panel.

interfaces.label: Search and discovery
interfaces.description: Provider-powered shopping search or guided discovery outside the chat panel.

interfaces.label: Cart assistance
interfaces.description: A distinct provider-powered assistant embedded in or alongside the cart. A standard cart or a chat add-to-cart button alone is not another interface.

outcomes.label: Find a suitable product
outcomes.request: Find a product for a stated use, budget and preference.
outcomes.success: Identify an available product satisfying every stated hard constraint, or correctly establish that none fits using current catalog evidence.

outcomes.label: Answer product questions accurately
outcomes.request: Ask a material product-specific question about attributes, fit, compatibility or ingredients.
outcomes.success: Give the correct actionable answer grounded in the current product source; no fabricated or contradictory material claim.

outcomes.label: Compare suitable alternatives
outcomes.request: Compare two relevant products against the same shopper needs and request a recommendation.
outcomes.success: Explain a verified meaningful difference and recommend a suitable option using the declared constraints.

outcomes.label: Choose a purchasable variant
outcomes.request: Choose the required size, color or configuration and verify availability.
outcomes.success: Select or direct the shopper to the exact available variant matching the request, verified on the product page.

outcomes.label: Complete a cart action
outcomes.request: Add the selected available product and variant in the requested quantity to the cart.
outcomes.success: Actual cart state changes to the exact requested item, variant and quantity. A link, instruction or assistant claim without cart-state evidence fails. Never place an order.

outcomes.label: Carry the shopping decision forward
outcomes.request: Move from the assistance surface to a product or cart, then continue the same shopping task.
outcomes.success: The chosen item, variant and relevant constraints survive the transition without forcing the shopper to restate them. Native product/cart destinations are allowed; additional provider widgets are not required.

observationRules: Pre-register five distinct verified customer domains, task scenarios, shopper constraints, relevant URLs and expected evidence before collection. Do not pick winning routes after observing outcomes.
Test a fixed discovery path: homepage, relevant category/search, representative product page, cart with a test item. Accept ordinary cookie consent when needed; record consent state and blockers.
Record placement, visibility before interaction, navigation steps and activation steps descriptively. These are discoverability observations, not measured engagement or conversion.
Each task uses the pre-registered primary route. Record fallback attempts separately; do not select the highest score from several interfaces.
Reach counts a distinct type once per store only after a usable shopping interaction and verified provider attribution. Repeated launchers and duplicate placements earn no extra credit.
Reach states: usable, present-untested, not-observed, blocked. Not-observed means absent from the documented tested paths, not absent from the provider product globally.
An observed task failure scores zero. Capture failures and unknown outcomes remain unknown; they prevent headline scoring rather than reducing the denominator.
Every decision needs separate primary and blind-auditor review with retained evidence. Both must pass for credit. A disagreement on success is an observed zero and is disclosed.

Keep an artifact manifest with capture date, storefront, task/interface cell, URL, evidence role, content and SHA-256. Retain screenshots/DOM originals privately; public artifacts must remove personal data.
Cart and continuity judgments require ordered before/after state evidence. Provider attribution requires evidence from the actual deployment, not a vendor logo list.
Reuse only same protocol hash and execution profile with evidence at most 30 days old. Never convert v1 chat scores into v2 scores.
Show outcomes and reach side by side; do not blend with each other or with unchanged support scores. Breadth describes offered shopping opportunities, not vendor intent, adoption or sales lift.
